official_sources.finding: COMMENT review creation requires Pull requests repository write. Readback exposes review ID/user/state/body/commit_id/submitted_at, not Actions run/job/token identity.

GITHUB_TOKEN-caused pull_request_review does not start another Actions workflow. Dispatch exceptions and approval-required PR opened/synchronize/reopened exceptions do not establish external Work delivery.
pull_request_review submitted is distinct from issue_comment and diff review comments. GITHUB_SHA may be merge commit, so read actual PR head and tree.
GitHub task filters include PR/author/title/label and activity reviews/comments/commit/merge; close events may coalesce. No documented latency or Actions-originated review guarantee found.
Artifact readback exposes ID/digest/workflow run/head repository/head SHA, not which job produced a member nor whether member came from provider HTTPS.
Fresh run/event/path/actor/attempt/head/repository records available, but actor is not provider origin.
Fresh run/job/head/steps can bind execution; no sanitized provider capture origin proof built in.

Verified attestations link build provenance to workflow/commit/event, not provider response truth. Reusable workflow helps stronger build isolation, not mandatory for minimal transport proof; no new attestation permissions adopted.
